newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares end off lows, futures positive.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares end off lows, futures positive.

text.p: 1640 GMT - Shares ended off their lows with futures moving into positive territory as traders predicted that the overall market could improve on Tuesday.
*After the market closed, Sonae Investimentos forecast 1996 profit could rise to 13.9 billion escudos from 12.9 billion the year before.
*Cash prices were depressed by some continued profit-taking but overall volume was a modest 2.9 billion escudos.
*PSI-20 .PSI20 ends 0.08 percent down but the October futures, the most heavily traded, end five points up at 4,837.
*Cimpor loses 1.8 percent after its chairman says the stock price is high but it closes above the 3,300 level at 3,319.

*Banco Chemical was the most heavily traded stock but the business was attributed to Banco Pinto & Sotto Mayor's BPSM.IN public offer to buy (OPA). The OPA still has not date but traders said the feeling was that it would be completed by October. "People who think that it is a good investment are buying," said one trader. BPSM has offered 1,650 escudos per share with the stock closing on Monday at 1,610.
*Banco Comercial Portugues and Portugal Telecom both suffered from the profit-taking.
*Drinks firm Unicer lost 1.4 percent after the market reacted negatively to the high extraordinaries in its first half results.
